hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; bin=$(git -C "${f%/*}" rev-parse --show-toplevel)/node_modules/.bin || exit 0; case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx) "$bin/oxlint" --fix "$f" >/dev/null; "$bin/biome" check --write "$f";; *.json|*.jsonc|*.css) "$bin/biome" check --write "$f";; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true

jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */AGENTS.md|*/CLAUDE.md|*/CLAUDE.local.md|*/SKILL.md|*/.claude/rules/*.md) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; root=$(git -C "${f%/*}" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; [ -f "$root/tests/agents.ts" ] && command -v bun >/dev/null || exit 0; bun "$root/tests/agents.ts" >&2 || exit 2; }
